transition.intent: Implement deterministic schema-versioned JSON command metadata from the existing public command registry.
transition.validation_command: cmake -S . -B build -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCLI_STARTER_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
transition.transition_validation_command: bash scripts/test-generate-command-metadata.sh && cmake -S . -B build -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCLI_STARTER_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
transition.decision_rule: Transition only when focused metadata generation validation and the baseline CMake/CTest flow both pass.

phase_model.purpose: Align the automation prompt with real repository validation by creating or replacing the missing completion check.
blocked_work: renaming the starter without explicit scope
exit_criteria: automation prompt no longer points at a missing command

phase_model.purpose: Maintain the CLI starter after completion criteria are machine-checkable.
blocked_work: broad new CLI feature work without explicit task
exit_criteria: a new starter feature scope is explicitly selected

phase_model.purpose: Pause routine write-capable automation after the starter template is complete and validation remains machine-checkable.
blocked_work: routine write-capable automation without a new selected scope
broad new CLI feature work without explicit task
exit_criteria: a new starter feature scope is explicitly selected and the phase manifest is reactivated

phase_model.purpose: Generate Bash, Zsh, and PowerShell completions from the starter command registry without installing files into the user environment.
exit_criteria: Bash, Zsh, and PowerShell outputs cover every public command
the existing CMake build and CTest baseline passes

phase_model.purpose: Generate a deterministic roff man page from the starter command registry without installing files into the user environment.
allowed_work: focused man page fixtures and tests
exit_criteria: the generated man page covers every public command and global option
the existing CMake build and CTest baseline passes

phase_model.purpose: Generate deterministic schema-versioned JSON metadata from the starter command registry without installing files.
exit_criteria: the JSON output covers every public command and global option
the existing CMake build and CTest baseline passes

required_gates.description: The local automation evidence includes tests/check_project_completion.py, and the checker validates transition-ready, post-transition maintenance, and maintenance-closure phase shapes.
required_gates.on_failure: Create or repair the dependency-free completion checker, or update the prompt and phase gate together.

required_gates.description: The C++ starter must configure, build, and pass CTest.
README and command reference should match actual starter behavior while the completion checker remains aligned with the active phase manifest.
Automation must not publish binaries or push unless explicitly requested.
